scope: pummpkin/mjlab development branch: contact response and ground material adapters. This commit does not change any frozen training snapshot.

reference.hdmi: Explicit softness formulation rather than treating relaxation time as invariant physical stiffness. Existing material restitution samples are retained; old HDMI DR ranges are not copied.
reference.physx: Actual source maximum depenetration velocity=1 m/s.

mapping: After native material mixing, positive (t,zeta) converted to direct (-1/t^2,-2*zeta/t); native refsafe timestep floor retained. Baseline stiffness matches original zeta=1; damping varies without 1/zeta^2 stiffness escalation.
penetration: After native constraint assembly, cap only positive penetration-bias target velocity bias/b to1 m/s for contact rows. Preserve friction coefficients, constraint impedance, solver iterations, joint/equality constraints and unconstrained physical velocities. Pyramidal rows share normal bias; pure elliptic friction rows skipped.
limits: Approximation, not identical PhysX restitution/contact solver.
Bias velocity limit is not a hard bound on realized separating velocity or joint speed.
Pinned to mujoco-warp3.11 private API. Must recapture CUDA graphs after model hook registration; unrelated models use original function.
Constant-stiffness mapping and bias cap are tested together; paired performance test does not assign benefit to one subcomponent.
validation: tests/unit/mjlab_contact_response/check_contact_response.py checks the contact kernels on CPU. An optional output-directory argument writes the report outside the source tree. Ground-pair regression is tests/unit/mjlab_ground_materials/check_cpu.py. GPU rollout and learning-performance evidence remain external.
